in_marathi.name: Kritvi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kritvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kritvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Krit' meaning 'created' or 'done' and 'Vish' meaning 'wealth'. This name is associated with the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It symbolizes the creation of wealth and abundance in one's life.
